# LEARNTHEUNLEARN

> Premier online math institution offering visual, intuitive math learning for Grade 1 through Grade 12. Founded by Priyadharshini M.Sc. Math, B.Ed.
> Motto: Learn Beyond Limits.

## Institution Metadata
- **Name**: LEARNTHEUNLEARN (Learn The Unlearn Math Institution)
- **Website**: https://learntheunlearn.com
- **Founder & Chief Educator**: Priyadharshini M.Sc. Math, B.Ed.
- **Motto**: Learn Beyond Limits
- **Grades Covered**: Grade 1, Grade 2, Grade 3, Grade 4, Grade 5, Grade 6, Grade 7, Grade 8, Grade 9 (Algebra I), Grade 10 (Geometry & Trigonometry), Grade 11 (Algebra II & Pre-Calculus), Grade 12 (Calculus & Advanced Math).
- **Core Methodology**: Visual spatial reasoning, unlearning rote memorization, mental speed arithmetic algorithms, and 1-on-1 diagnostic mentorship.

---

## Founder Overview
Priyadharshini holds a Master of Science in Mathematics (M.Sc. Math) and a Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.). She leads LEARNTHEUNLEARN with a mission to help primary, middle, and high school students overcome math anxiety by replacing formula memorization with intuitive visual understanding.

---

## Detailed Curriculum Breakdown by Grade

### Grade 1 Math Curriculum
- Numbers & Counting
- Number Patterns
- Comparing Numbers
- Base Ten Blocks
- Place Value
- Addition
- Subtraction
- Fractions
- Measurement
- Counting Money
- Telling Time
- Geometry
- Data & Graphing
- Word Problems

### Grade 2 Math Curriculum
- Skip Counting
- Place Value & Rounding
- Addition
- Subtraction
- Multiplication
- Fractions
- Measurement
- Counting Money
- Telling Time
- Geometry
- Data & Graphing
- Word Problems

### Grade 3 Math Curriculum
- Place Value & Rounding
- Addition
- Subtraction
- Multiplication
- Division
- Order of Operations
- Roman Numerals
- Fractions & Decimals
- Measurement
- Counting Money
- Time & Calendar
- Geometry
- Data & Graphing

### Grade 4 Math Curriculum
- Place Value & Rounding
- Addition
- Subtraction
- Mental Multiplication
- Multiply in Columns
- Mental Division
- Long Division
- Order of Operations
- Roman Numerals
- Fractions
- Decimals
- Measurement
- Geometry
- Factoring
- Data & Graphing

### Grade 5 Math Curriculum
- Place Value & Rounding
- Addition & Subtraction
- Multiplication & Division
- Order of Operations
- Fractions - Add/Subtract
- Fractions - Multiply/Divide
- Fractions - Converting
- Fractions vs Decimals
- Decimals - Add/Subtract
- Decimals - Multiplication
- Decimals - Division
- Measurement
- Geometry
- Factoring
- Exponents
- Data & Graphing
- Integers
- Algebra
- Word Problems

### Middle School Math (Grades 6–8)
- Ratios & Proportional Reasoning
- Operations with Negative Integers & Absolute Value
- One-Variable & Multi-Step Linear Equations
- Scale Factor Drawings, Area & Volume of Prisms
- Slope-Intercept Form (y = mx + b)
- Systems of Linear Equations
- Scientific Notation & Pythagorean Theorem
- Probability & Data Distributions

### High School & Advanced STEM (Grades 9–12)
- Grade 9 (Algebra I): Quadratic Functions, Polynomial Operations, Factoring, Exponential Growth & Decay.
- Grade 10 (Geometry & Trigonometry): Euclidean Proofs, Right Triangle Trig (SOH CAH TOA), Circle Theorems, Laws of Sines & Cosines.
- Grade 11 (Algebra II & Pre-Calculus): Complex Numbers (a + bi), Logarithmic & Exponential Equations, Unit Circle Trigonometry, Conic Sections, Sequence Limits.
- Grade 12 (Calculus & STEM Math): Differential Calculus (Derivatives, Chain Rule, Optimization), Integral Calculus (Definite/Indefinite Integrals, Riemann Sums), Differential Equations, Vectors & Data Science Math.

## Admissions & Customer Inquiries
- **Process**: Parents and students submit inquiries specifying Student Name, Email ID, Contact Number, Current Grade (Grade 1–12), and specific learning goals.
- **Offer**: Complimentary 1-on-1 visual math diagnostic session and customized learning roadmap.
- **Contact**: learntheunlearn.math@gmail.com | +91 73584 84736
